description: This Java class defines the entity 'Transaction' for the sales management system. It models a payment transaction with properties like amount, date, types, associated order, transaction details, and audit information. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and implements serialization and JSON conversion interfaces.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a payment transaction, including fields for amount, date, transaction and payment types, associated order, and transaction details, with JPA mappings for database persistence.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section data for the transaction.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section data for the transaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the transaction.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the associated order for this transaction.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an order with this transaction.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Defines the amount for the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the transaction.

methods.name: setTransactionDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the transaction.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction details as a String.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets detailed description of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDetails
methods.description: Returns the map of transaction-specific details.

methods.name: setTransactionDetails
methods.description: Assigns a map of details to the transaction.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the transaction details map to a JSON string for external representation.
